title: Psychedelic Astronaut Vision
description: A surreal black and white line-art astronaut stands centrally with a large spherical head containing three stylized eyes and tears. The figure holds a staff topped with a ringed planet and has a backpack. Below the main figure are two large expressive faces adorned with leaves. The background features vibrant, smoky gradients of purple, pink, orange, green, and red, with numerous outlined triangles containing smaller scenes and symbols.
